title: Emerald
desc: Named and developed 'Emerald', a full-stack platform to fetch, normalise, and visualise energy market time-series data. Features live updates via WebSockets integrated with TanStack Table, deployed on AWS Elastic Beanstalk for scalable data processing.

title: Trailstone Config Service
desc: Collaborated on a config service enabling dynamic application tuning. Allows users to modify config settings and inject new TSIDs into the Emerald tables instantly, removing the need to submit developer tickets for code redeployment.

title: Laochra 2D Game
quickDesc: A Viking-themed 2D adventure built with Pygame.
desc: A top-down adventure game demonstrating Object-Oriented Programming principles. Features a custom engine for sprite animation, AABB collision detection, and complex state management.

title: TacoCloud
quickDesc: Full-stack system based on 'Spring in Action'.
desc: A comprehensive study application developed following the 'Spring in Action' curriculum. Demonstrates mastery of the Spring ecosystem, utilising Spring MVC for the web layer, Spring Security for authentication, and Spring Data JPA for persistence.

title: Nutrition Meal App
quickDesc: Nutrition tracking and meal planning application.
desc: A comprehensive tool for dietary management. Allows users to create recipe databases, track daily caloric intake against targets, and auto-generate shopping lists from weekly meal plans.

title: Staff Rota System (TM356)
desc: Re-engineered a workplace legacy system for the TM356 module. Focused on modernising the UI and optimising backend logic to resolve scheduling conflicts and improve staff management efficiency.

title: Major Project (TM470)
desc: The final capstone project for my degree. Currently in the research and proposal phase, defining scope and architectural requirements.

title: ciaranc.dev
desc: A server-side rendered portfolio built with Flask and Python. Utilises Tailwind CSS for styling and HTMX for lightweight, dynamic frontend interactions. Hosted on PythonAnywhere.

title: Desktop Banking Suite
desc: A desktop-based financial application demonstrating core Object-Oriented Programming principles. Features a graphical user interface for secure account creation, transaction processing, and real-time balance management.
